title: ErrorResponse
description: Body of every non-2xx response from the hub, the runner and the Vercel fallback.

code.description: invalid_request 400, too_large 413, forbidden_origin 403, turnstile_failed 403, rate_limited 429, busy 503 (run slots full: fall back), use_primary 409 (fallback refuses while on-prem is healthy), unavailable 503 (this backend cannot run code now), internal 500.

error.message: All run slots are in use.
